churn_risk_signals.description: Behavioural patterns suggesting customer disengagement or intent to leave
sap_indicators: declining order frequency over 3 or more consecutive months
declining average order value over 3 or more consecutive months
narrowing product category mix — ordering fewer categories than historical baseline
extended gap between orders vs historical average cadence
complete cessation of orders for 4 or more weeks in a previously active account
crm_indicators: no CRM activity logged in 30 or more days
NPS score decline of 3 or more points since last measurement
renewal opportunity within 90 days with no recent activity
support ticket open and unresolved for more than 21 days
renewal opportunity stage not updated in 45 or more days

risk_levels.confirmed: 3 or more signals present across both systems
risk_levels.possible: 2 signals present, or signals from one system only
risk_levels.watch: 1 signal present — monitor but no immediate action required

order_pattern_change.description: Statistically meaningful change in a customer ordering behaviour
order_pattern_change.calculation: compare order frequency and average value in last 90 days vs prior 90 days
order_pattern_change.meaningful_threshold: 20 percent or more decline in frequency or value

crm_engagement_decline.description: Reduction in sales and support touchpoints with a customer

cross_signal_analysis.description: Synthesis of SAP behavioural signals and CRM engagement signals
cross_signal_analysis.approach: flag customers where two or more signals from different systems align
cross_signal_analysis.priority: customers with signals in both systems are higher risk than those with signals from one system only

product_category_mix.description: The range of product categories a customer orders across
product_category_mix.calculation: count distinct categories ordered in last 90 days vs prior 90 days
product_category_mix.signal: reduction of 2 or more categories is a meaningful narrowing signal
